-- Add index to the main ID table for the final join
CREATE INDEX idx_temp_all_ids_respondent_sequence_number ON temp_all_ids (respondent_sequence_number);

-- FINAL MASTER TABLE
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS final_master_table;
CREATE TABLE final_master_table AS
SELECT
    a.respondent_sequence_number,
    t0."age_in_years_at_screening",
    t1."doctor_told_you_have_diabetes",
    t2."glycohemoglobin",
    t3."right_visual_acuity_presenting"
FROM temp_all_ids a
LEFT JOIN temp_master_age_in_years_at_screening t0 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t0.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_doctor_told_you_have_diabetes t1 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t1.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_glycohemoglobin t2 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t2.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_right_visual_acuity_presenting t3 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t3.respondent_sequence_number;

CREATE INDEX idx_final_master_respondent_sequence_number    
    ON final_master_table (respondent_sequence_number);
-- ========== STEP 1: Inclusion ==========

-- STEP 1.1: Includes all patients aged 20 or older
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_inclusion_step1 AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM final_master_table
WHERE "age_in_years_at_screening" >= 20;

-- ========== STEP 2: Exclusions ==========

-- STEP 2.1: Exclude patients with missing demographic age
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step1 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_inclusion_step1 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."age_in_years_at_screening" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.2: Exclude patients with missing diabetes diagnosis
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step2 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step1 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.3: Exclude patients with missing glycohemoglobin level
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step3 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step2 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."glycohemoglobin" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.4: Exclude patients with missing visual acuity
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step4 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step3 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."right_visual_acuity_presenting" IS NOT NULL;

-- ========== STEP 3: Cohort ==========

-- The final temp table in the exclusion sequence becomes temp_cohort.
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_cohort AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step4;

-- ========== STEP 4: Variables ==========

-- 4.1 Visual Acuity Categories
-- Extract raw visual acuity for the cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_visual_acuity_raw AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."right_visual_acuity_presenting"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- Categorize visual acuity
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_visual_acuity_categories AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number",
       CASE
           WHEN "right_visual_acuity_presenting" IN ('20/20', '20/25') THEN 'Normal Vision'
           WHEN "right_visual_acuity_presenting" IN ('20/30', '20/40', '20/50') THEN 'Mild Impairment'
           WHEN "right_visual_acuity_presenting" IN ('20/60', '20/80') THEN 'Moderate Impairment'
           WHEN "right_visual_acuity_presenting" IN ('20/200', '20/200+') THEN 'Severe Impairment/Blindness'
           ELSE NULL
       END AS "visual_acuity_categories"
FROM temp_visual_acuity_raw;

-- 4.2 Diabetes
-- Extract raw diabetes diagnosis and glycohemoglobin for the cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_diabetes_raw AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."doctor_told_you_have_diabetes",
       f."glycohemoglobin"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- Determine diabetes status based on diagnosis or glycohemoglobin level (using 6.5 as threshold)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_diabetes_status AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number",
       CASE
           WHEN "doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" = 'Yes' OR "glycohemoglobin" >= 6.5 THEN '1'
           ELSE '0'
       END AS "diabetes"
FROM temp_diabetes_raw;

-- ========== STEP 5: Final Table ==========
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_final_table AS
SELECT
  c."respondent_sequence_number",
  vac."visual_acuity_categories",
  ds."diabetes"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN temp_visual_acuity_categories vac ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = vac."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_diabetes_status ds ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = ds."respondent_sequence_number";
